routes.approach: The classical reconstruction supplier is now integrated. Import WattsFoundation.ReconstructionFromSmallProjectiveGenerator and Proofs.EilenbergWatts. A shared-slot check in the consumer environment, using only the project and its existing package build paths, elaborated the exact reviewed correspondence proposition and audited the reconstruction declaration. The checked declaration supplies the two Hom equivalences after the smallness conversion. The correspondence and its evaluation formulas still need proof. First check a local smallness lemma for a symbolic category C, generator P, index I : Type v and family X : I → C. Give the AddCommGrpCat direct-sum cofan injections DirectSum.of and construct its IsColimit with DirectSum.toAddMonoid, toAddMonoid_of, and addHom_ext. Apply the endpoint preservation premise to the cofan with legs Sigma.ι X. Use isColimitOfPreserves and Cofan.isColimitMapCoconeEquiv to get the mapped colimit. Identify the comparison from the direct sum to Hom(P, sigmaObj X) by its injections, then take bijectivity of its isomorphism. Install Projective from each reviewed premise and use the hom universe v for LocallySmall. Apply reconstruction separately at (A,P) and (E,Q). For each returned L use the inverse of H ⋙ L ≅ Id as unit and L ⋙ H ≅ Id as counit. Whisker by the source inverse and the target Hom equivalence. Lift both directions to Good using the finite-colimit and discrete preservation instances and additivity. Apply the registered article EilenbergWatts inverse to the opposite endomorphism rings in the reviewed module universe. Check the regular identification in its own lemma. Use ULift.down followed by unop and End.asHom to identify the lifted regular R with HP.obj P. Verify in this lemma that conjugated right multiplication by op p corresponds to HP.map (End.asHom p). Transport through the source equivalence unit to identify evaluation of the whiskered functor at the lifted regular with evaluation at P. Construct the direct bimodule functor with object HQ.obj (F.obj P), right action by postcomposition with F.obj.map (End.asHom p), and morphism map HQ.map (θ.app P). Precomposition by End.asHom q gives the left action, and associativity and naturality give the bimodule and naturality laws. Use the regular comparison to obtain the natural bimodule isomorphism to this direct functor, then use changeFunctor. Verify the actual functor equality after forgetting on both objects and morphisms, and compute the two formulas through the resulting cast. The planned ProjectiveGeneratorModuleReconstruction edge still refers to a separate choice-free endpoint and remains in deps. Once the exact article proof has compiled and passed the axiom audit with the local reconstruction module in its import closure, that receipt is evidence for an owner decision on removing the held edge for this article item alone. The pointwise choice-free reconstruction and the held portal endpoints retain their existing scope.
